name: spatial_dense_reach_level2_wrist_125d
description: A robot manipulation benchmark focusing on dense spatial reaching tasks using wrist-centric observations (125-dimensional). It measures a policy's ability to reach target positions reliably under contact-aware conditions and varying initial states. Data typically includes proprioceptive state and sensor observations for learning control or imitation policies.
reputation: A niche contact-aware robotics benchmark used by researchers working on manipulation and reach policy learning; modest community adoption.
